label: Transfer overview to onward boarding gate
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport transfer-route overview into the final onward boarding gate frame. Follow the transfer route from the overview toward the gate without rotating the camera, keeping the movement calm, reassuring, and efficient for a connecting traveler. Suggest a flight information display and a short jet bridge approach near the gate, but keep them abstract — no specific gate numbers or airline logos. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not add fixed gate numbers, flight times, shopping brands, extra lounge claims, or new factual signage. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
